seoTitle: Free CSV Column Extractor - Pick or Drop Columns
metaDescription: Keep, reorder or drop CSV columns by header name or position, remove duplicates and export CSV, plain lines or JSON. Free and runs in your browser.
intro: Selects, reorders or removes columns from a CSV by header name, column number or range, with optional de-duplication and CSV, line or JSON output.
why: Exports from CRMs, shops and analytics tools usually contain far more columns than you need. Opening a 40-column file in a spreadsheet just to copy two of them is slow, and it is a risk when the file holds personal data. With this tool you type the columns you want, such as "email,country" or "1,3-5", and get only those back. You can invert the choice to drop columns instead, keep the original header or not, and remove duplicate rows to get a unique list. The one-value-per-line output is handy for pasting email addresses into another system. It all happens in your browser, so the file contents are not sent anywhere.
howTo: Paste your CSV and set the delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab or pipe).
Type the columns as names or numbers, separated by commas. Ranges such as 2-4 work. Choose keep or drop.
Tick duplicate removal if needed, choose CSV, one value per line or JSON, and copy the result.

faq.q: Can I mix names and numbers?
faq.a: Yes. Each item is first matched against the header names, then read as a range like 2-4, then as a 1-based column number. The order you type is the order of the output columns when you keep them.

faq.q: What if there is no header row?
faq.a: Untick "First row is header". Columns are then numbered 1, 2, 3 and so on, and all rows are treated as data. JSON output then uses those numbers as keys.

faq.q: How are quotes and line breaks handled?
faq.a: The parser follows the usual CSV quoting rules: quoted fields, doubled quotes and line breaks inside quotes are read correctly, and output cells are quoted again where needed. An unterminated quote gives an error.

faq.q: What does one value per line do with several columns?
faq.a: When more than one column is selected, the values of each row are joined with a space on one line. For clean lists, select a single column.
